name: cable wide grip lat pulldown
description: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
